featured_reviews.review_text:
My look change prince So experienced person thank you so much.......(Nanoplastiia Treatment)
The staff is extremely professional, courteous, and attentive, making the entire experience smooth and relaxing. The salon maintains great hygiene, and the overall vibe is very welcoming👌

featured_reviews.name: Lalita Mali
featured_reviews.review_text: In the name of nano they will do blue tox. For 1st timers its gud bt if u hav hair issues, never visit them, they will do any thing without thoroughly checking ur hair quality and other issues like greying. They din blue tox although they said they r doing nano, asked for highlights that also it was hardly visible, then my touch ups went useless so i had to do all again over the bluetox, finally after 1 month only my hair lost the shine. Wast of my money. Please see to it tht u discuss well before going for the services.

featured_reviews.name: Divya Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Ms.Chandani did a great job ... Her experience and practical work was well done ... I am confidently recommend her for waxing and eyebrows and many more things . Please try her once than believe me , she will not disappoint you ... Thanks to Ms. Chandani and All the best for your future .

Highly NOTTTT RECOMMENDED!!
